title: Platinum Plus Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?
summary: For the Platinum Plus Account, interest accrues at 7.0% APY and compounds daily. Interest is credited monthly, and if the credit date falls on a non-business day it is typically reflected on the next business day within the monthly cycle.
